name: stability
title: Measure again, grade again
idea: Measuring again and grading again changes some pair relations; stability has to be read beside disclosure, because withholding every pair is perfectly stable.
from: new concept · theory book ch. 17 (stability needs its own repeated-data law); picture: two replications of the league side by side with their relation changes, and a replay histogram of the share of changed relations beside N/M and E/N for several rules
credit: After the postrank theory book, ch. 17.
caption: Fixed-truth paired measurement experiment; every observation refits its stipulated posterior.
